name: repo-context-verifier
description: Local Codex control bridge for bounded context, process governance, artifact-aware stopping, and evidence-based completion.

interface.shortDescription: Govern context, builds, polling and verification
interface.longDescription: Local MCP control bridge that bounds repository orientation and command output, recognizes completed build artifacts, limits asynchronous deployment polling, and refuses full completion until required evidence is recorded.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Repo Context Verifier to govern this repository task from bounded orientation through direct verification, then stop when the required deliverables are complete.
